references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Low back pain and sciatica in over 16s: assessment and management
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked. The landing page shows Published 30 November 2016 and Last updated 29 July 2026. The Update information section states that in July 2026 NICE withdrew the recommendations on psychological therapy for low back pain or sciatica. Earlier recorded updates include the December 2020 review of opioid recommendations for non-cancer pain.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Suspected neurological conditions: recognition and referral
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked. The landing page shows Published 1 May 2019 and Last updated 2 October 2023. The Update information section states that in October 2023 recommendations 1.3.1, 1.4.2 and 1.7.4 were updated in line with NHS England's standard on faster diagnosis of cancer.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Spinal injury: assessment and initial management
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked. The landing page shows Published 17 February 2016 and does not display a separate Last updated date. The Update information section records a May 2021 clarification to recommendation 1.5.7: MRI should always be performed after CT when there is a neurological abnormality that could be attributable to spinal cord injury.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Spinal metastases and metastatic spinal cord compression
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked. The landing page shows Published 6 September 2023 and does not display a separate Last updated date. The Update information section states that the September 2023 guideline updates and replaces NICE guideline CG75 from November 2008. NICE also records minor changes since publication.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Cellulitis and erysipelas: antimicrobial prescribing
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked on 1 August 2026. The overview page shows Published 27 September 2019 and does not display a separate Last updated date. The recommendations cover excluding non-infectious causes of redness, marking the extent of infection, treatment, reassessment, referral and antimicrobial choice. Source metadata was AI-assisted and requires local clinical governance review before publication.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Venous thromboembolic diseases: diagnosis, management and thrombophilia testing
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked on 1 August 2026. The overview page shows Published 26 March 2020 and Last updated 2 August 2023. NICE records a further surveillance review on 1 May 2026 and states that the guideline will not be updated to add recommendations on early mobilisation or bed rest after treatment for venous thromboembolism. Source metadata was AI-assisted and requires local clinical governance review before publication.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Peripheral arterial disease: diagnosis and management
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked on 1 August 2026. The guidance page shows Published 8 August 2012 and Last updated 11 December 2020. It covers recognition, diagnosis and management of lower-limb peripheral arterial disease, including severe limb ischaemia features. Source metadata was AI-assisted and requires local clinical governance review before publication.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Diabetic foot problems: prevention and management
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked on 1 August 2026. The overview page shows Published 26 August 2015 and Last updated 11 October 2019. NICE records that the guideline was reviewed on 3 July 2025 and that recommendations on treatment of diabetic foot ulcer in relation to topical oxygen therapy are planned for update. Source metadata was AI-assisted and requires local clinical governance review before publication.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Gout: diagnosis and management
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked on 1 August 2026. The overview page shows Published 9 June 2022 and no separate Last updated date. The guideline directs clinicians assessing a painful red swollen joint to consider septic arthritis, calcium pyrophosphate crystal deposition and inflammatory arthritis, and to refer immediately through the local pathway when septic arthritis is suspected. Source metadata was AI-assisted and requires local clinical governance review before publication.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Head injury: assessment and early management
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked on 1 August 2026. The overview page shows Published 18 May 2023 and does not display a separate Last updated date. The guideline updates and replaces CG176. NICE records minor changes since publication, including amendments concerning anticoagulant and antiplatelet risk factors, observation timing and a March 2025 link removal. Source metadata was AI-assisted and requires local clinical governance review before publication.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Sore throat (acute): antimicrobial prescribing
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked on 1 August 2026. The overview page shows Published 26 January 2018 and does not display a separate Last updated date. Recommendation 1.1.3 directs clinicians to use FeverPAIN or Centor criteria to identify people more likely to benefit from antibiotics. NICE records minor changes through November 2025. Source metadata was AI-assisted and requires local clinical governance review before publication.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Pneumonia: diagnosis and management
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked on 1 August 2026. The overview page shows Published 2 September 2025 and does not display a separate Last updated date. The guideline updates and replaces CG191, NG138 and NG139 and includes assessment of community-acquired pneumonia using CRB-65 and CURB-65 where appropriate. NICE records minor updates in November 2025 and January 2026. Source metadata was AI-assisted and requires local clinical governance review before publication.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Acute kidney injury: prevention, detection and management
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked on 1 August 2026. The guidance page shows Published 18 December 2019 and Last updated 16 October 2024. It covers recognition, risk assessment, detection and management of acute kidney injury, including use of serum creatinine, urine output and medication review. Source metadata was AI-assisted and requires local clinical governance review before publication.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Acute coronary syndromes
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked on 1 August 2026. The guidance page shows Published 18 November 2020 and does not display a separate Last updated date. The guideline covers diagnosis and management of acute coronary syndromes, including high-sensitivity troponin testing within the appropriate clinical pathway. NICE's March 2026 exceptional surveillance review did not recommend updating its antiplatelet recommendations. Source metadata was AI-assisted and requires local clinical governance review before publication.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Chronic heart failure in adults: diagnosis and management
references.notes: Official NICE reference URL checked on 1 August 2026. The guidance page shows Published 12 September 2018 and Last updated 3 September 2025. The guideline includes the use and interpretation pathway for natriuretic peptide testing in suspected chronic heart failure, including BNP and NT-proBNP. NICE also records minor clarifications in October and December 2025. Source metadata was AI-assisted and requires local clinical governance review before publication.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Intravenous fluid therapy in adults in hospital
references.notes: Official NICE guidance checked on 1 August 2026. It provides assessment and monitoring principles for adult fluid and electrolyte needs, including indicators of hypovolaemia, fluid balance, weight, renal function and the need to reassess treatment. Its scope is adult hospital inpatients and it should be applied with local governance in ambulance, urgent care and hospital-at-home settings.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Multimorbidity: clinical assessment and management
references.notes: Official NICE guidance checked on 1 August 2026. It covers personalised care for multimorbidity and includes recommendations on frailty assessment, caution during acute illness, treatment burden, medicines and individual goals.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Delirium: prevention, diagnosis and management in hospital and long-term care
references.notes: Official NICE guidance checked on 1 August 2026. The January 2023 update recommends the 4AT when indicators of delirium are present and highlights acute cognitive, behavioural and functional changes, including hypoactive delirium.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Falls: assessment and prevention in older people and in people 50 and over at higher risk
references.notes: Official NICE guidance checked on 1 August 2026. This guideline replaced CG161 and covers comprehensive falls assessment, including frailty, cognition, postural blood pressure, dizziness, gait, medication, nutrition, continence, vision and home hazards.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Hypertension in adults: diagnosis and management
references.notes: Official NICE guidance checked on 1 August 2026. It defines a significant postural blood pressure fall as at least 20 mmHg systolic or 10 mmHg diastolic after standing for at least 1 minute and recommends review of likely causes and medicines.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Stroke and transient ischaemic attack in over 16s: diagnosis and initial management
references.notes: Official NICE guidance checked on 1 August 2026. The guideline covers rapid recognition, referral and imaging for stroke and TIA. NICE recorded a surveillance review on 27 March 2026 without changing the core acute recognition recommendations.

references.organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
references.title: Medicines optimisation: the safe and effective use of medicines to enable the best possible outcomes
references.notes: Official NICE guidance checked on 4 August 2026. It covers medicines reconciliation, medication review, communication at transitions of care and person-centred medicines optimisation.

references.organisation: British Geriatrics Society
references.title: Comprehensive Geriatric Assessment Hub
references.notes: BGS CGA resources checked on 4 August 2026. They describe CGA as a multidimensional, interdisciplinary process covering physical, functional, psychological, social and environmental needs and producing a coordinated care plan.
